- `ManageBusinessDialog` cannot be told by a caller which user opens it. A non-staff user whose business has no email, no authentication and no affiliated account gets `noAuthenticationOptions = true`, and the dialog then falls back to the registry-request option (`businessHasNoEmailAndNoAuthenticationAndNoAffiliation` sets `requestAuthBusinessRegistryOption`).
- A `getAuthentication` failure other than 404 sets `hasBusinessAuthentication = true`. The passcode option can then show for a business whose real state is unknown.
- AdministrativeBN allows creating a BN request only when `taxId` is missing or shorter than 15 characters. `businessNumber` is optional and is sent in the URL when present.

- Only ACTIVE (status 1) memberships appear in the view from dede70a6df1e onward. Pending, rejected and inactive members get no authorization rows.
- Because the view uses LEFT JOINs from membership, a member of an org with no affiliations still appears, with NULL business identifier and entity name.
- After 06c7acc047fa the view no longer exposes `preferred_payment_code`. Any reader selecting that column would fail; this topic does not show who reads it.
- The BCOL backfills pass `bcol_user_id` to bcol-api, where the GET needs the `system` role. The service-account token is intended to satisfy this, but the role mapping is not shown here.

- **Affiliation invitation requests:** with the `AffiliationInvitationRequestAccess` flag off, invitations are never loaded, so no invite or request flags appear on businesses.
- **Credit card is stored as DIRECT_PAY:** the UI shows DIRECT_PAY as CREDIT_CARD, and `createOrg` and `updateOrg` convert CREDIT_CARD back to DIRECT_PAY before sending.
- **PAD validation lets failures through:** `validatePADInfo` returns `isValid: true` on any error or non-200 verification, so a failed bank check does not block account creation.
- **Staff permissions:** staff with `Role.StaffManageAccounts` get the admin permission set. Those with `Role.StaffViewAccounts` get the view-only set with `MembershipType.User`. Staff with only `Role.Staff` get no permissions, since `permissions` stays `[]`.

- `Account-Id` falls back to the request header whenever the token has no claim. A caller can therefore supply the account via the header. The authorization of that header is not shown in this topic.
- `is_staff_admin` means the `STAFF_CREATE_ACCOUNTS` role only. The name suggests a wider scope.
- Re-running `create_app` rebuilds the caches (idempotent overwrite).
- `mask_email` passes through any value with other than exactly one `@`.

- The `can` directive does nothing when no `CurrentAccount` is in session, so every element guarded by `v-can` is left fully accessible and visible before an account is chosen. It is a UI aid only; the server must enforce permissions.
- `displayMode` never removes `v-card--disabled`. If `viewOnly` flips back to false, the element stays disabled until it is re-rendered.
- `useAccount().getAccountFromSession()` calls `getItem` with `'CurrentAccount' || '{}'`, which is just the key. If nothing is stored, `JSON.parse(null)` returns `null`, so callers get `null`, not `{}`.
- `isPremiumOnly` access is granted to IDIR users regardless of org. Others need a premium org and an Admin or Coordinator membership. Active-account checks apply only to BCSC and BCEID users and GOVM account users.

- If a BCEID user has an `invToken`, it is checked before the terms of use. A user who has not accepted the terms is still sent to the confirm-token page.
- A non-Active membership resets the current org, so `AccountMixin` getters then read an empty org.
- Calling `getNextPageUrl()` twice for BCEID returns different results. The first call removes `InvitationToken` and `AffidavitNeeded` from the session.
- `AccountOverview` and `AccountOverviewNSF` both show the overdue view with different data shapes. The first lists statements; the second shows NSF fee and totals.

- **AccountService** (behaviour from `legal_api/services/bootstrap.py`):
  - `create_affiliation`: no token -> 401; `affiliate.status_code != CREATED or entity_record.status_code != CREATED` -> 400.
  - `update_entity`: no token -> 401; PATCH `{AUTH_SVC_URL}/entities/{business_registration}` not 200 -> 400.
  - `delete_affiliation`: `affiliate.status_code != OK or entity_record.status_code not in (OK, NO_CONTENT)` -> 400.
  - `get_affiliations`: no token -> None; non-200 -> None.
  - `get_bearer_token`: client credentials with the `ACCOUNT_SVC_*` config keys; returns None on exception; timeout `ACCOUNT_SVC_TIMEOUT`, default 20 seconds.
  - `get_account_by_affiliated_identifier`: returns None on exception.
